title: Integrale
identity: Hans Ulrich Engelmann’s Integrale, Op.14a is a saxophone-and-piano work. The University of the Arts Helsinki archive holds a digitized 2009 recording featuring saxophonist Irene Schacker and pianist Else Stock-Hug, but access is restricted to library workstations. A Darmstadt bibliography dates the work to 1954.
